messages.subject: about "MaAsLin error has occurred"
parts:
Hi~
   Recently,I am working on analyzing the relationships between Cirrhosis and gut microbiota composition and would like to use MaAsLin as an investigative tool to control the sample's confounding factors such as age, sex and BMI.  
 When I run MaAsLin on a galaxy page, the  output always prompted "A MaAsLin error has occurred. It typically happens when incorrect 'Last metadata row' was selected For demo data please choose 'Weight'"even if I selected 'BMI' for my data set. I have checked my data and there is no missing value or special symbol in it. My data format is detailed in attachment. Will I be able to tell where the error occurred?

​
